tableInfo.what_a: A dinner table at Versailles on Calle Ocho, every Tuesday at 6:30, for people in Sylvester's survivorship program. Up to eight people, a menu with the portions already worked out, and a ten-minute walk down Eighth after. Early dinner, food you know, a walk, and company: everything on your plan, in one evening.
tableInfo.host_a: {name} hosts. Hosts are people from the program who finished treatment a few years ago. They save the table and say hello. Not a doctor, not a coach, nobody selling anything.
tableInfo.pay_a: Nobody at the table. Donors cover the plates through Sylvester Comprehensive Cancer Center, about {seat} a seat. If a family paid for this Tuesday, the table card says so.
tableInfo.catch_a: None. There's nothing to buy and nothing to sign. Saying yes saves you a seat; the host sees your first name and anything you don't eat, nothing else. Skip any week and nobody asks why.
